name: heidisql-sessions
title: HeidiSQL Sessions
description: Search and launch your HeidiSQL sessions from Raycast.
author: THEN00P

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.subtitle: HeidiSQL
commands.description: Search and launch your HeidiSQL sessions.

preferences.name: heidiExePath
preferences.title: HeidiSQL Executable
preferences.description: Optional. Path to heidisql.exe (Windows) or heidisql.app (macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: on Windows from PATH, Scoop, or the default install location; on macOS from /Applications or ~/Applications.

preferences.name: portableMode
preferences.title: Session Source
preferences.label: Force portable mode
preferences.description: Windows only. Portable mode is auto-detected when a portable_settings.txt sits next to the executable (e.g. Scoop installs). Enable this only to force reading from portable_settings.txt when auto-detection can't. Has no effect on macOS, which always reads ~/.config/heidisql/settings.json.

preferences.name: showOpenEntry
preferences.title: Extra Entry
preferences.label: Show an "Open HeidiSQL" entry
preferences.description: Always show an entry that opens HeidiSQL without a session.
